_comment: Plugin ZIPs the LIVE gate serves to the browser instead of fetching them through the
playground's download proxy (test/helpers/serve-zips.mjs). Kept in the repo rather than
downloaded at gate time because GitHub does not promise archive bytes stay identical,
so a pinned hash on a fresh download could fail for no reason of ours. Outside test/ and
fixtures/ so the mutation harness does not copy 3 MB once per mutant.
Both are GPL-3.0-or-later; origins are recorded in COPYRIGHT.
